title: Artificial Intelligence
tagline: From the Turing test to foundation models.

events.title: The Turing test is proposed
events.text: Alan Turing publishes “Computing Machinery and Intelligence”, asking whether machines can think and proposing the imitation game as a practical test.

events.title: The Dartmouth workshop coins “AI”
events.text: McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester and Shannon organise the summer workshop where the field formally names itself “artificial intelligence”.

events.title: The Perceptron
events.text: Frank Rosenblatt builds the Mark I Perceptron, an early neural network for pattern recognition, igniting decades of connectionist research.

events.title: ELIZA simulates a therapist
events.text: Joseph Weizenbaum's ELIZA demonstrates conversational chatbot behaviour, showing how easily people anthropomorphise even simple scripts.

events.title: Backpropagation revival
events.text: Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams popularise the backpropagation algorithm, making multi-layer neural network training practical.

events.title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
events.text: IBM's Deep Blue becomes the first computer to defeat a reigning world chess champion in a match, winning 3.5–2.5.

events.title: AlexNet wins ImageNet
events.text: Krizhevsky, Sutskever and Hinton’s deep convolutional network crushes the ImageNet competition, catalysing the modern deep-learning boom.

events.title: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol
events.text: DeepMind’s AlphaGo beats a world champion Go player 4–1, a milestone for reinforcement learning and search in strategy games.

events.title: Transformers arrive
events.text: Vaswani et al. introduce the transformer architecture with self-attention, the foundation of most modern large language models.

events.title: GPT-3: massive language models
events.text: OpenAI’s GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters shows emergent few-shot ability, foreshadowing the current era of foundation models.

events.title: ChatGPT reaches the public
events.text: OpenAI launches ChatGPT, bringing conversational generative AI to hundreds of millions of users within months.
